analysis: The supplied units contain no direct security regression. Changes: (1) .github/workflows/integration.yml, default-posture smoke lane (base 307-363, head 307-345). It now expects DARKBLOOM_TESTBED_EXPECT_KV_BACKEND=paged instead of contiguous, and fails if DARKBLOOM_CBV2_KV_QUANTIZATION is set in addition to the existing DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PAGED_KV check. The job still uses read-only HF auth on push only and unauthenticated downloads on pull_request. Action pins, secrets handling and permissions are unchanged, so no new CI trust surface. (2) CHANGELOG.md is documentation only. It says provider attention caches default to rotated K4/V4 packed KV with a native recent tail. It also says packed historical attention checkpoints publish only at whole prefill frontiers, and that legacy tensor and Diffusion native-prefix codecs are refused for packed storage. Relevant threats: T-041 (prefix cache and SSD tier: salt scoping, HMAC lookup tags, DBK3 metadata, adoption bound and frontier-only publication), T-028 (residual KV and GPU memory), T-007 and T-027 (output integrity). The underlying Swift provider code (KVCacheSSD, EngineV2 factory and bridge, cacheSalt plumbing) is not in this batch, so I have no evidence on whether the packed-KV or checkpoint changes preserve cacheSalt folding into chain hash and HMAC tag, AAD contents, the 30-minute TTL or disk guards. The next pass should check those source files if they are in the PR. Do not treat this clean result as clearing them.
